hero.headline: Care that feels
hero.subcopy: Consult your trusted doctor from home, share your symptoms and reports securely, and receive a digital prescription — reviewed personally, every time.

doctor.voiceQuote: Age is just a number on a chart—weight and organ health are what truly determine the safe and effective dose of a medication.
doctor.title: The same doctor you already trust — now online.
doctor.subtitle: Healthify is a digital extension of one doctor's practice, not a marketplace. Every consultation reaches your doctor directly, personally.
doctor.assurePersonal: Every case read by the doctor personally

steps.title: See your doctor online in 4 easy steps
steps.subtitle: No travel and no waiting room. Here is everything you need to do, one step at a time.
steps.step1Desc: Sign up with your name, email and phone number — or just use your Google account.
steps.step1Point2: Use the site in English or Hindi
steps.step2Desc: Write what is wrong, since when, and how you feel. Add photos or old reports if you have them.
steps.step2Point1: Photos and PDF reports up to 5 MB
steps.step2Point2: Only your doctor can see it
steps.step3Desc: Pick Standard, Priority or a Video call. You see the fee first, then pay safely online.
steps.step3Point2: Video calls happen right here on the site
steps.step4Desc: The doctor reads your case personally and sends a signed prescription to your account.
steps.step4Point1: Download it as a PDF anytime
steps.step4Point2: All your past prescriptions stay saved
steps.step3DescNoVideo: Pick Standard or Priority. You see the fee first, then pay safely online.

prescription.title: Your prescription stays with you.
prescription.desc: Once your doctor responds, your prescription is generated and saved securely in your Healthify portal — view it anytime or download it as a PDF for the pharmacy or your records.
prescription.point1: Available in your portal as soon as it's ready
prescription.point2: Downloadable as a clean, printable PDF

access.title: For when visiting the clinic isn't easy
access.desc: Whether you live outside the city, find travel difficult, or simply need a quick follow-up, Healthify brings your doctor's care to wherever you are.

security.title: Your information stays protected
security.item1Desc: Your account is protected with encrypted authentication.
security.item2Desc: Your health details are only accessible to you and your doctor.
security.item3Desc: Payments are processed securely through Razorpay.
security.item4Desc: Only you and your doctor can access your prescriptions.

emergency.title: Not for medical emergencies
emergency.desc: Healthify is not intended for medical emergencies. If you are experiencing severe or life-threatening symptoms, please seek immediate emergency medical care.

finalCta.title: Your doctor is now closer than ever.
finalCta.subtitle: Start a consultation in a few minutes, from wherever you are.

footer.tagline: Your trusted doctor's care, now accessible online.
footer.emergencyNote: Healthify is not intended for medical emergencies. In an emergency, seek immediate in-person medical care.

tips.title: Small daily habits that keep you well
tips.disclaimer: General wellness guidance — not a substitute for advice about your own condition.

water.title: Drink 8–10 glasses of water a day
water.desc: Staying hydrated supports digestion, energy and kidney health. Sip through the day — more in summer heat.

sleep.title: Sleep 7–8 hours every night
sleep.desc: Regular, sound sleep helps your body repair, steadies blood pressure and keeps your mind sharp.

walk.title: Walk at least 30 minutes daily
walk.desc: A brisk daily walk strengthens your heart, helps control blood sugar and lifts your mood.

plate.title: Fill half your plate with vegetables and fruit
plate.desc: Fresh, home-cooked meals with less salt, sugar and oil keep weight and cholesterol in check.

medicine.title: Take medicines exactly as prescribed
medicine.desc: Don't skip doses or self-medicate — the right dose depends on your weight and health, not age alone.

handwash.title: Wash hands for 20 seconds
handwash.desc: Soap and water before meals and after the washroom is one of the simplest ways to stop infections.
